items.title: Flash PMI shows Japan factories leading strongest growth since February
items.summary: The acceleration in output growth, combined with near record selling price inflation and a sustained rise in employment, strengthens the case for the Bank of Japan to proceed with a rate hike at its September meeting.
items.summaryZh: 产出增长的加速，加上接近创纪录的销售价格通胀和就业的持续增长，加强了日本央行在9月会议上继续加息的理由。
items.summaryEn: The acceleration in output growth, combined with near record selling price inflation and a sustained rise in employment, strengthens the case for the Bank of Japan to proceed with a rate hike at its September meeting.
